verdict.rationale: Gusto's platform explicitly supports both W-2 employee payroll (regular/off-cycle runs, tax filing, benefits) and 1099 contractor payments (direct deposit, check, historical payment methods) from the same account/API, per docs-44, docs-52, docs-9/18/26/61, and docs-27. Community reviews corroborate strong core payroll experience (gusto-comm-1, gusto-comm-8). missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of running combined W-2+1099 payrolls together in one run, and one community anecdote (gusto-comm-3) noted confusion about contractor-only use, though this doesn't contradict combined support for mixed workforces.
